display.purpose: Fraunces serif hero/section headlines only. Ceiling ~3.75rem.

body.purpose: Inter for all prose, prices, forms, and UI chrome.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Cards and product tiles at rest.

shadows.name: cover-hover
shadows.purpose: Lift on hovered interactive book covers.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Default easing for reveals and state transitions — fast out, gentle settle, no bounce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default CTA for the whole buy flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.37 0.17 278)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.99 0.01 250)); font: 500 0.875rem Inter, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,40,0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.37 0.17 278)) 90%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.37 0.17 278)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action; hairline on the ground with warm hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--background, oklch(0.99 0.004 250)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.26 0.06 280)); font: 500 0.875rem Inter, sans-serif; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.9 0.013 255)); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.93 0.05 67)); color: var(--accent-foreground, oklch(0.45 0.12 55)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.37 0.17 278)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field with navy focus language.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; padding: 4px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.26 0.06 280)); font: 400 0.875rem Inter, sans-serif; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.9 0.013 255)); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,40,0.05); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.5 0.035 272)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.37 0.17 278)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.37 0.17 278)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Book tile — flat at rest, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; padding: 16px; background: var(--card, oklch(0.995 0.003 250)); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(20,20,40,0.08); transition: box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(20,20,40,0.14); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-cover { aspect-ratio: 3/4; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--secondary, oklch(0.95 0.035 235)), var(--accent, oklch(0.93 0.05 67))); margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-title { font: 600 1.125rem Inter, sans-serif; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.26 0.06 280)); margin: 0; } .ds-card-price { font: 600 0.875rem Inter, sans-serif; color: var(--primary, oklch(0.37 0.17 278)); margin: 4px 0 0; }

components.name: Sparkle Badge
components.description: Orange accent badge — the sparkle pop, used sparingly.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 10px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--brand, oklch(0.74 0.145 62)) 20%, transparent); color: var(--brand-foreground, oklch(0.26 0.09 280)); font: 500 0.75rem Inter, sans-serif; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Kayana Book brand wordmark — navy ink + orange sparkle.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { font: 600 1.5rem Fraunces, serif; color: var(--primary, oklch(0.37 0.17 278)); text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-wordmark span { color: var(--brand, oklch(0.74 0.145 62)); }

narrative.overview: Kayana Book takes its whole visual identity from its own logo: a navy-ink wordmark next to a monkey reading, lit by orange and cyan sparkles. It is a secondhand bookstore — single-copy used books across every genre, sold with honest condition photos. Confident navy type carries structure and trust; warm orange and cyan appear as punctuation. This is a brand register — the store is the ad, so even the cart and order-tracking screens wear the identity. Bright, not loud: the energy comes from a small number of saturated pops against generous quiet space. Fun is manufactured by craft — the Fraunces display serif, purposeful reveal motion, a springy tap — never by cartoon clip-art. Every playful move must survive one test: would a buyer still trust this bookstore with their money? A secondhand shop has to feel like a curated treasure hunt, not a bargain bin.
keyCharacteristics: Navy ink for structure; orange + cyan reserved as sparkle accents (≤10% of a screen).
Fraunces display serif over Inter body — contrast pairing, not two similar sans.
Flat at rest; depth arrives on interaction (hover, focus, dialog).
Bouncy, tactile feedback — motion is part of the build, gated behind reduced-motion.
Mobile-first, thumb-reachable, fast on mid-range devices.

rules.name: The Sparkle Budget Rule
rules.body: Orange and cyan combined occupy ≤10% of any given screen. Their rarity is the delight; spend them on one hero accent, a badge, a progress bar — not on every element. Navy does the work.

rules.name: The No-Warm-Ground Rule
rules.body: The background is a cool near-white, never cream/sand/paper. Warmth comes from the orange accent and Fraunces type, never a tinted body background.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-Special Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for headings and the wordmark only. Body, forms, prices, and UI chrome stay Inter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth appears only in response to state — hover lift, the 3px focus ring, or an overlay.

dos: Do anchor every screen in Ink Navy and spend orange/cyan as sparkle accents on ≤10% of the surface.
Do keep the background a cool near-white; carry warmth through the orange accent and Fraunces type.
Do use Fraunces for headings and the wordmark only; Inter for everything else.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and let depth answer interaction.
Do add springy, tactile feedback and always ship a prefers-reduced-motion alternative.
Do verify contrast: body and placeholder text ≥4.5:1. Orange and cyan are decoration, never body text on white.
donts: Don't build a generic Indonesian marketplace: no banner spam, no badge noise, no cluttered grids.
Don't use childish clip-art, Comic Sans, or rainbow gradients.
Don't ship cold corporate SaaS: no sterile gray, personality-free screens.
Don't use gradient text (bg-clip-text + text-transparent). The current welcome.tsx hero does this and should be replaced with solid navy plus one orange accent word.
Don't set orange or cyan as body text on the near-white ground; it fails contrast.
Don't use border-left/border-right >1px as a colored accent stripe.
